review.item_premise: Complete public declarations or candidate causes and closure assertions are retained with their exact result. Candidate and publication verifiers are distinct; immutable access never promotes a proposed context to an admitted or published state. No secret, encoding recipe or deployment authentication is introduced; observation supplies none of the verifier premises. Verification retains exact one-boundary lead and separate candidate/publication authority; structural cause coherence is shared without sharing verifier results. Grid error allowance must cover one quantum; smaller declarations are refused before production.
